article.title: Verification of claims.
article.content:
39Verification of claims.

39. [Verification of claims.] Omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 (6 of 2026), s. 25 (w.e.f. 26-05-2026).
